LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description: A chapter of the story: its place in the chain and the level caps it sets.

completed_level_cap.description: The level cap once the player completes the chapter; above level_cap.
completed_level_cap.title: Completed Level Cap

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

level_cap.description: The level cap while this is the player's current chapter: every chapter before it completed, this one not. The first chapter's is the cap of a new player.
level_cap.title: Level Cap

name.description: The chapter's name, shown when a player completes it.

order.description: Position in the story: 1 for the first chapter, then 2, 3.
order.title: Order
